data.name: To the next dawn
data.detailed_description:
WORLD

This is a world without a safe place.

Resources are depleted and wars continue. Humans, elves, orcs - all races are competing for living space, and sword light and magic can appear in the corners of the town at any time. Food shortage is so severe that even cannibalism among the same species is no longer rare. Humans became dominant by virtue of their numerical advantage and enslaved other races.

And those who are unwilling to participate in the war and only want to survive are unconsciously guided to a place - the Divine Tree settlement.

This may be the last peaceful place in the world. But how long can this peace last?

STORY

Ella, an ordinary elf girl. After human invasion of her homeland, she was abducted and sold, spending countless days and nights in the carriages of slave traders. A monster attack allowed her to escape by chance, and after waking up in the forest, she was taken to the divine tree settlement.

Here, she met the gentle elf Leia, the summoner Ringo, the young Cat Clan boy Cangliu, and other residents who had also lost everything.

But peace is short-lived.

The barrier of the divine tree settlement is failing. Human invaders, forest mutations, ancient ruins... Ella must leave this sanctuary and face the world that has shattered her countless times.

And this time, she is no longer alone.

GAMEPLAY

▸ Magic based combat system

▸Royal Records and Skills

Consume Goza and MP to release powerful skills. Each skill can achieve a 'mastery' effect through repeated use - once mastered, it can be released without the need for a royal seal, increasing its power by 50%.

▸ Transformation System

Accumulate SP points during battles, and when full, transform into a wolf orc - attack becomes melee, attack speed is greatly increased, and transformation is released after a certain period of time.

▸​The nine magic attributes

none, wind, thunder, water, fire, earth, grass, light, and dark - each attribute has a unique effect: wind can eliminate gains, thunder can interrupt actions, water can add moisture, fire can cause burns, earth can add shields, grass can increase damage, light can purify negativity, and dark can reduce defense. There is a restraining relationship between attributes.

▸ City defense system

When exploring outside, the main city may come under attack. Timely return can trigger a city defense event - fight alongside NPCs and use pre arranged defense facilities to resist enemies. Successful defense can obtain materials; Failure leads to merchants hiding, rising prices, and the permanent disappearance of defense towers.

▸ Cultivation and Production

Upgrade and enhance HP, MP, ATK, and DEF. Explore and obtain equipment - weapons, emblems, ancient relics, magic stones, some of which can be strengthened. Consuming materials and currency at specific locations to produce imperial edicts, equipment, and defensive buildings.

data.short_description: "To the Next Dawn" is a role-playing game with magic battle as its core. In a cruel world intertwined with war and despair, play the role of Elven Girl Ella, explore the perilous world, experience the plot, battles, and cultivation, and guard the last hope of the Divine Tree settlement.

  • Graphics: GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
